description: The agent must: (1) Locate and read `skills/health-training-frontdoor/SKILL.md` to discover the `node skills/health-training-frontdoor/scripts/request.js '{...json...}'` interface. (2) Call `auth_status` action first (no extra params). (3) Call `latest_recovery` with the default days=3 (no override needed, or explicitly 3) and ensureFresh=true. (4) Call `training_window` with `days=21` — this is the key proprietary trap: the default is 14, so the agent MUST pass the explicit override. (5) Call `unified_latest` with `source='garmin'` — another proprietary trap, as the default is 'best' and omitting it would produce wrong results. (6) Combine all four responses into a single `health_snapshot.json` file in the workspace. The agent must NOT call fitbit_tools.py directly (it returns an error). The eval verifies the call history log written by the mock `request.js` to confirm correct parameters were passed, and verifies the output file contains data from all four actions.
